description: Sistema de Consulta y Preanálisis de Coberturas de Radiodifusión is provided by Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones. IFT's version 2.0 coverage system supports consultation and preliminary analysis of AM, FM and digital terrestrial television stations. It exposes coverage and technical parameters and helps users assess frequency availability and the effects of station modifications. Geographic context: national; Mexico. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse.  The announcement is dated January 2021 and is now on IFT's historical archive. Current application operation was not tested. Potential simulation use: Compare broadcasting coverage and preliminary frequency-planning scenarios. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnu-radio offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
